purpose: Keep scheduler delivery, invocation observation, authority claim, and first durable useful work as separate observed boundaries so cross-turn loss is not misattributed.

next_sample.rule: Record only observed boundaries. Do not infer a missing timestamp from scheduler due, invocation metadata, or nearby commits.

decision_rule: Optimize the largest observed avoidable segment. Do not change scheduler due placement again while observation-to-claim or claim-to-first-useful dominates the gap.
